title: John F. Kennedy is assassinated in Dallas
summary: President John F. Kennedy was shot and killed while riding in a motorcade through Dealey Plaza in Dallas. Lee Harvey Oswald was arrested for the murder.
reason: Oswald, a former Marine who had lived in the Soviet Union, fired from the Texas School Book Depository.
significance: The killing shocked the world and Lyndon Johnson became president.
place: Dealey Plaza, Dallas, Texas, United States
